6.34 rsDuplicateChartFormulaParameter
Applies to RDL 2008/01
rsDuplicateChartFormulaParameter is a critical error that will occur when two or more
ChartFormulaParameters.ChartFormulaParameter elements have the same Name attribute within the
same ChartFormulaParameters collection.
